rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is not awake or responsive.

example.english: They hit their head and became unconscious.
example.traditional: 佢撞親個頭，成個人冇知覺。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zong6 can1 go3 tau4 sing4 go3 jan4 mou5 zi1 gok3

rows.note: Use this when a response or action happens without the person realizing it.

example.english: I was unconscious of biting my lip.
example.traditional: 我不自覺咁咬住個嘴唇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bat1 zi6 gok3 gam3 ngaau5 zyu6 go3 zeoi2 seon4

rows.note: Use this for a subconscious reaction or a skilled action carried out without conscious control.

example.english: I made the unconscious move of pressing the familiar button without thinking.
example.traditional: 我下意識咁按熟咗個掣，完全唔使諗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 ji3 sik1 gam3 on3 suk6 zo2 go3 zai3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 sai2 nam2
